A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' residing on the [[planet]] [[Lazerian IV]] was an eccentric [[Noble/Legends|noble]]. At some point, he purchased a [[ruined outpost]] on the continent of [[Laz]]&mdash;once the site of an ancient [[Battle on Lazerian IV|battle]] involving [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]&mdash;and made it part of his estate. The area was heavily monitored, and trespassing by outsiders was forbidden. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] population of Lazerian IV&mdash;the [[Lazerian (people)|Lazerians]]&mdash;regarded his land as nothing more than an eyesore.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The noble was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
